{{Quote|She's a ''Firespray'' Pursuit Special&hellip;one of six prototypes manufactured for the prison. She's the last of her kind now.|Jango Fett after "acquiring" ''Slave I''|audio=LastOfHerKind-SWBH.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: Bounty Hunter">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Firespray-31''-class patrol and attack craft''', or '''''Firespray''-class starship''', or '''''Firespray''-class interceptor''', was a patrol and [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] designed by [[Kuat Systems Engineering/Legends|Kuat Systems Engineering]] initially for use by the [[Republic Correctional Authority/Legends|Republic Correctional Authority]]. The most well known of the starships was [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango]] and [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] ship, the [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']].

==Characteristics==
[[File:SlaveI_egvv.jpg|thumb|left|150px|''Slave I'' schematics]]
As a prisoner transport, the ship featured numerous holding cells and devices made for the most exotic of creatures. A trademark of the ship was that it landed horizontally with the drive engines facing the surface and the cockpit facing upward. To transition to normal flight mode, the ship rotated so that the cockpit faced forward while the drive engines faced rearward.

The stock ship was well armed and armored for its size, with on-board storage space and room for several passengers and/or cargo. Roughly as fast as [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr's]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]/[[Bomber/Legends|bomber]], the ship had more than enough speed and maneuverability to intercept [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and other renegades.

==History==
{{Quote|Torn one beat-up ''Firespray'' right down to the frame and rebuilt it&mdash;''"<br />"''A ''Firespray''? I thought those ships were just legend!|Deliah Blue and Ona Antilles|<ref name="Legacy 49">[[Legacy (2006) 49|''Legacy'' (2006) 49]]</ref>}}
[[File:InertialDampeners-XWM.png|thumb|left|150px|An [[Aggressor assault fighter/Legends|Aggressor assault fighter]] firing on a ''Firespray'']][[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] Systems Engineering produced six prototypes shortly before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Battle of]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. However, all but one were destroyed when [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] staged a prison break on [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]]. Jango kept the sole remaining ''Firespray'', renaming it [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']]. Kuat Systems Engineering, suffering from the financial loss of the prototypes, eventually mothballed the project and concentrated instead on starship upgrades.

Many years later, K.S.E. found themselves on a more secure financial footing, and again desired to enter the starship market. The company then re-introduced the ''Firespray''-class, hoping to build upon the reputation of the remaining prototype and its legendary [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. Fett would still be using the ship by the year [[43 ABY]].

The new ''Firespray''s were, like the original prototypes, designated as patrol and attack ships and perfectly suited for law enforcement and interdiction missions. With Kuat Systems Engineering keen to expand the market for the ship, they had started to promote how easily the ship could be customized and upgraded to fulfill a myriad of roles.

At least ten were used by the [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="Revenants" /> By [[137 ABY]], these ships were legendary, but regarded as myth. During this time, [[Deliah Blue]] claimed that she once found and rebuilt one that was in such an advanced state of disrepair as to be falling apart.
